title: How platform methods stay reproducible
summary: Financial calculations use exact versioned methods, declared inputs, units, assumptions, and provenance so results can be reproduced and reviewed.

items: Each method has a stable ID, version, owner, input, output, and validation bounds.
Pure method code does not use a network, provider SDK, clock, random source, model, or storage system.
Results retain the exact method, policy, and input lineage needed for review.

body.text: Calculated and simulated values are not observed market facts and do not become personal investment advice.

applicability.label: Financial calculations, simulations, scenarios, and backtests
